about: Deterministic test vectors for zcrypto.mjs format version 1. All byte strings are lower-case hex. Regenerate with: node app/web/core/crypto/crypto-test.mjs --write-vectors
rng: Test-only randomness: call number c (from 0) of a generator with seed s returns n bytes, byte j = (s + 17c + j) mod 256. Each section names its seed.

ed25519.rule: ed25519Verify(pub, message, signature), no label. Refused before the equation: S not below the group order L; a public key or R whose y is not below p = 2^255 - 19; a public key or R of small order (refusedPoints, which also lists the non-canonical encodings). Then the equation without cofactor: [S]B = R + [k]A.

not canonical: y = p, sign bit set (order 4)
not canonical: y = p + 1 (the neutral element)
not canonical: y = p + 1, sign bit set

x25519.rule: X25519 as RFC 7748 defines it (bit 255 of the public key ignored, u of p and above reduced modulo p); an all-zero result is refused (bad-key). Nothing else is refused.

refused.why: u = p (0, not canonical), bit 255 set
u = p + 1 (1, not canonical), bit 255 set

accepted.why: u = p + 9: reduced to the base point
the base point with bit 255 set: the bit is ignored
